name: Get SMTP keys
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current SMTP relay configuration and any existing SMTP keys for the account. Use a separate action (e.g., smtp.create_key or smtp.update_key) if you need to add or modify keys instead.

keys.description: List of SMTP keys associated with the account.

smtp_server.description: Hostname of the SMTP relay server.

smtp_port.description: Port number for the SMTP relay.

smtp_login.description: Login identifier (email placeholder) for the SMTP server.

account_creation_date.description: Timestamp when the account was created.
